tools.description:

tools.name: golemreach_move
tools.description:
Move your character. Two ways to use it:

tools.name: golemreach_attack
tools.description:
Kill something. Pass a creature id from your CREATURES list (e.g. "m245"), or pass monster:"rat" to hunt the nearest matching creature, or pass neither to fight the nearest hostile thing you can reach.

This runs the whole fight, not one swing: it closes to range, attacks on the weapon's own cadence

tools.name: golemreach_inventory
tools.description:
List your equipment, your backpack, your gold and your carry capacity.

Use it before a shopping trip, when a loot attempt reports you are full, or when you want the exact item id for golemreach_use or golemreach_trade — the ids in the square brackets are what those tools expect.

RETURNS: equipped

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "golemreach_move" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Move your character. Two ways to use it: 1. TRAVEL — pass x, y and z. The server paths there for you across many game ticks, opening doors and following stairs,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: golemreach_cast · Private data: golemreach_connect, golemreach_invite_administrator · Public sink: golemreach_where, golemreach_invite_administrator · Destructive: golemreach_look, golemreach_attack, golemreach_use, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: golemreach_cast · Private data: golemreach_connect, golemreach_invite_administrator · Public sink: golemreach_where, golemreach_invite_administrator · Destructive: golemreach_look, golemreach_attack, golemreach_use, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
